011import org.scijava.plugin.Plugin;
012import paint.shared.config.TrackMateConfig;
013import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
014import paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog;
015import paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface;
016import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
017import paint.shared.objects.Project;
018import paint.shared.utils.*;
019
020import javax.swing.*;
021import java.awt.*;
022import java.nio.file.Path;
023import java.time.LocalDateTime;
024import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
025import java.util.ArrayList;
026import java.util.List;
027
028import static paint.fiji.trackmate.RunTrackMateOnRecording.runTrackMateOnRecording;
029import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
030import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectPathResolver.getValidProjectPath;
031
032/**
033 * Main user interface class for running TrackMate interactively within the
034 * PAINT environment. Handles initialization, configuration, dialog management,
035 * and execution of TrackMate processes.
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings("unused")
038@Plugin(type = Command.class, menuPath = "Plugins>Glyco-PAINT>Run Single")
039public class TrackMateUISingle implements Command {
040
041    /**
042     * Prevents concurrent execution of multiple TrackMate runs.
043     */
044    private static volatile boolean               running = false;
045    private        volatile TrackMateSingleDialog singleDialog;
046    private        volatile String                lastRecordingName = "";
047    private        volatile int                   lastThreshold     = 5;
048
049    /**
050     * Executes the TrackMate workflow through an interactive GUI dialog.
051     * <p>
052     * The method:
053     * <ul>
054     *   <li>Ensures single-instance execution.</li>
055     *   <li>Initializes logging and configuration state.</li>
056     *   <li>Displays a project dialog for experiment selection.</li>
057     *   <li>Runs the appropriate TrackMate pipeline (sweep or standard).</li>
058     *   <li>Optionally triggers GENERATE_SQUARES after completion.</li>
059     * </ul>
060     */
061    @Override
062    public void run() {
063
064        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
065        // Step 1 – Setup exception handler and concurrency lock
066        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
067        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, throwable) ->
068                                                          PaintLogger.debugf("AWT complained: %s", throwable.getMessage())
069        );
070
071        if (running) {
072            showWarning("TrackMate processing is already running.\nPlease wait until it finishes.");
073            return;
074        }
075
076        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
077        // Step 2 – Retrieve project root
078        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
079        Path projectPath = getValidProjectPath();
080        if (projectPath == null) {
081            return;
082        }
083
084        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
085        // Step 3 – Initialize logging, configuration, and runtime settings
086        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
087        paint.ui.console.PaintConsoleWindow.createConsoleFor("TrackMate");
088        PaintConfig.initialise(projectPath);
089
090        String debugLevel = PaintPrefs.getString("Runtime", "Log Level", "INFO");
091        PaintLogger.setLevel(debugLevel);
092        PaintLogger.initialise(projectPath, "TrackMateOnProject.log");
093        PaintLogger.debugf("TrackMateUISingle.run - TrackMate plugin started (Interactive).");
094
095        PaintRuntime.initialiseFromPrefs();
096
097        // Log version and timestamp
098        JarInfoLogger.JarInfo info = JarInfoLogger.getJarInfo(TrackMateUISingle.class);
099        if (info != null) {
100            PaintLogger.infof("Compilation date: %s", info.implementationDate);
101            PaintLogger.infof("Version: %s", info.implementationVersion);
102        }
103
104        LocalDateTime  now           = LocalDateTime.now();
105        String         formattedTime = now.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
106        PaintLogger.infof("Current time: %s", formattedTime);
107        PaintLogger.infof("New single version 5 November");
108        PaintLogger.blankline();
109
110        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
111        // Step 4 – Show experiment dialog
112        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
113        ProjectDialog projDialog = new ProjectDialog(null, projectPath, ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE);
114        paint.ui.console.PaintConsoleWindow.closeOnDialogDispose(projDialog.getDialog());
115
116        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
117        // Step 5 – Handle OK action callback
118        projDialog.setCalculationCallback(project -> runTrackMateSingle(project, projDialog));
119        projDialog.showDialog();
120    }
121
122    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
123    // Utility Methods
124    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
125
126    /**
127     * Displays a warning dialog with the specified message.
128     *
129     * @param message warning message text to display
130     */
131    @SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
132    private void showWarning(String message) {
133        JOptionPane optionPane = new JOptionPane(message, JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
134        JDialog warnDialog = optionPane.createDialog(null, "Warning");
135        warnDialog.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
136        warnDialog.setVisible(true);
137    }
138
139    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
140    private boolean runTrackMateSingle(Project project, ProjectDialog projDialog) {
141
142        if (running) {
143            showWarning("TrackMate processing is already running.\nPlease wait until it finishes.");
144            return false;
145        }
146
147        // SINGLE mode expects exactly one experiment
148        if (project.getExperimentNames() == null || project.getExperimentNames().size() != 1) {
149            showWarning("Please select exactly one experiment.");
150            return false;
151        }
152
153        final Path   projectRoot    = project.getProjectRootPath();
154        final Path   imagesPath     = project.getImagesRootPath();
155        final String experimentName = project.getExperimentNames().get(0);
156        final Path   experimentPath = projectRoot.resolve(experimentName);
157
158        List<ExperimentInfo> infos = MainIOInterface.readExperimentInfo(experimentPath);
159        if (infos == null || infos.isEmpty()) {
160            showWarning("No ExperimentInfo.csv found or it is empty for:\n" + experimentPath);
161            return false;
162        }
163
164        List<String> recordingNames = new ArrayList<>();
165        for (ExperimentInfo ei : infos) {
166            if (ei != null && ei.getRecordingName() != null && !ei.getRecordingName().trim().isEmpty()) {
167                recordingNames.add(ei.getRecordingName().trim());
168            }
169        }
170
171        if (recordingNames.isEmpty()) {
172            showWarning("No recording names found in ExperimentInfo.csv.");
173            return false;
174        }
175
176        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
177        // Show TrackMateSingleDialog (MODELESS) so Calculate does NOT close it
178        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
179
180        // Build TrackMate config exactly how you do it in batch
181        final TrackMateConfig trackMateConfig      = new TrackMateConfig();
182        final Path            imagePath            = imagesPath.resolve(experimentName);
183        final String          initialRecordingName = chooseInitialRecording(recordingNames, lastRecordingName);
184        final int             initialThreshold     = chooseInitialThreshold(infos, initialRecordingName, lastThreshold);
185
186        lastRecordingName = initialRecordingName;
187        lastThreshold     = initialThreshold;
188
189        PaintLogger.infof(trackMateConfig.toString());
190
191        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
192            Window owner = projDialog.getDialog();
193
194            // Prevent opening duplicates
195            if (singleDialog != null && singleDialog.isDisplayable()) {
196                singleDialog.toFront();
197                singleDialog.requestFocus();
198                return;
199            }
200
201            singleDialog = new TrackMateSingleDialog(
202                    owner,
203                    recordingNames,
204                    initialRecordingName,
205                    initialThreshold,
206                    (recName, threshold) -> handleCalculate(
207                            recName,
208                            threshold,
209                            infos,
210                            experimentPath,
211                            imagePath,
212                            trackMateConfig,
213                            projDialog
214                    ),
215                    (recName, threshold) -> handleSave(
216                            recName,
217                            threshold,
218                            infos,
219                            experimentPath
220                    )
221            );
222
223            singleDialog.setThresholdProvider(recordingName -> chooseInitialThreshold(infos, recordingName, lastThreshold));
224
225            singleDialog.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
226            singleDialog.setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
227            singleDialog.setVisible(true);
228        });
229
230        return true;
231
232    }
233
234    private void handleCalculate(String recName,
235            int                  threshold,
236            List<ExperimentInfo> infos,
237            Path                 experimentPath,
238            Path                 imagePath,
239            TrackMateConfig      trackMateConfig,
240            ProjectDialog        projDialog) throws Exception {
241
242        ExperimentInfo experimentInfoRecord = findExperimentInfoByRecording(infos, recName);
243        if (experimentInfoRecord == null) {
244            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Selected recording not found in ExperimentInfo.csv: " + recName);
245        }
246
247        running = true;
248        // Log the recording the user actually selected. This used to log infos.get(0), i.e. the
249        // first recording in Experiment Info.csv, whichever one was being processed.
250        PaintLogger.infof("   Recording '%s' started TrackMate processing with threshold %d.",
251                          experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName(), threshold);
252        try {
253            runTrackMateOnRecording(
254                    experimentPath,
255                    imagePath,
256                    trackMateConfig,
257                    threshold,
258                    experimentInfoRecord,
259                    projDialog
260            );
261        } finally {
262            running = false;
263        }
264        PaintLogger.blankline();
265
266        lastRecordingName = recName;
267        lastThreshold     = threshold;
268    }
269
270    private void handleSave(String recName,
271            int threshold,
272            List<ExperimentInfo> infos,
273            Path experimentPath) throws Exception {
274
275        ExperimentInfo experimentInfoRecord = findExperimentInfoByRecording(infos, recName);
276        if (experimentInfoRecord == null) {
277            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Selected recording not found in ExperimentInfo.csv: " + recName);
278        }
279
280        experimentInfoRecord.setThreshold(threshold);
281
282        MainIOInterface.writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile(
283                experimentPath.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV),
284                infos
285        );
286
287        lastRecordingName = recName;
288        lastThreshold     = threshold;
289    }
290
291    private ExperimentInfo findExperimentInfoByRecording(List<ExperimentInfo> infos, String recName) {
292        if (infos == null || recName == null) {
293            return null;
294        }
295        String target = recName.trim();
296
297        for (ExperimentInfo ei : infos) {
298            if (ei == null) {
299                continue;
300            }
301            String rn = ei.getRecordingName();
302            if (rn == null) {
303                continue;
304            }
305            if (rn.trim().equals(target)) {
306                return ei;
307            }
308        }
309        return null;
310    }
311
312    private String chooseInitialRecording(List<String> recordingNames, String preferred) {
313        if (recordingNames == null || recordingNames.isEmpty()) {
314            return "";
315        }
316        if (preferred != null) {
317            String p = preferred.trim();
318            if (!p.isEmpty()) {
319                for (String r : recordingNames) {
320                    if (r != null && r.trim().equals(p)) {
321                        return p;
322                    }
323                }
324            }
325        }
326        return recordingNames.get(0).trim();
327    }
328
329    private int chooseInitialThreshold(List<ExperimentInfo> infos, String recName, int fallback) {
330        ExperimentInfo experimentInfo = findExperimentInfoByRecording(infos, recName);
331        if (experimentInfo == null) {
332            return fallback;
333        }
334        double threshold = experimentInfo.getThreshold();
335        if (threshold < 1) {
336            return 1;
337        }
338        if (threshold > 50) {
339            return 50;
340        }
341        return (int) threshold;
342    }
343}
